timeline.title: Satellite lifespans
timeline.alt: Timeline of five satellites over about twenty-seven years. Terra and Aqua fade as they near the end of service, Suomi NPP's FIRMS production ends, and NOAA-21 lights up when it enters FIRMS.
timeline.verify: Retirement and FIRMS dates are unverified [verify]. A faded bar = after its planned end.
steps.title: Steps in the record
ratio.visible: Where both sensors overlap, VIIRS counts ×{ratio} what MODIS Aqua counts. That is the step in the chart.
ratio.flat: In this data VIIRS and Aqua counts are close in the overlap years, so there is no visible step. The sensors still sample differently (pixel size, swath).
ratio.none: There are no overlap years in this data, so no ratio is shown.
figure.label: Figure 1.
figure.caption: Simplified illustration of the harmonization workflow: raw hotspot archives become one Aqua-referenced series, which is then validated. Not to scale.
figure.alt: Workflow diagram with eight numbered steps drawn one after another, left to right and then back along a second row.

slider.note: Simplified illustration. Raw = the reference-chain platform's own counts, spliced as recorded. Uncertainty is not drawn here.

sources.title: Sources & notes
key.title: What the marks mean
key.modis: Large dot with a glow: a MODIS hotspot (Terra, Aqua)
key.viirs: Small triangle: a VIIRS hotspot (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21)
key.swath_modis: Teal band: a MODIS satellite pass
key.swath_viirs: Indigo band: a VIIRS satellite pass
key.line: Ember line: harmonized (Aqua-equivalent) hotspots per year
key.illustrative: Positions are illustrative. Each mark is drawn at a random spot inside a cell of the synthetic fixture and stands for several detections. Ember colour is used only for hotspots.
pipe.title: The five boxes
pipe.note: Ingest = steps 1 and 2 of Figure 1. Clean = 3 and 4. De-dup = 5. Match to Aqua = 6. Validate = 7 and 8.
